i1.title: Elie Saab Girl of Now Rose Petal Eau de Parfum 90ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Girl of Now, dressed in fresh rose petals.

Elie Saab Girl of Now Rose Petal Eau de Parfum 90ml is a fresh fruity floral fragrance for women, launched in 2024 as part of the Girl of Now family. A spark of Sichuan pepper and juicy pink peach opens it, a heart of magnolia and rose brings a soft petal bouquet, and it settles into blond woods and a clean white musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Sichuan Pepper, Pink Peach
  • Heart: Magnolia, Rose
  • Base: Blond Woods, White Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Elie Saab
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 90ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Fresh
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A sparkling Sichuan pepper and pink peach opening
  • A soft magnolia and rose heart
  • A clean blond woods and white musk base
  • Generous 90ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Girl of Now Rose Petal smell like?

Sichuan pepper and pink peach first, then magnolia and rose, finishing with blond woods and white musk.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
